description: Reproduction of signed illustration. Clusters of dots form the image of a woman wearing a graduation cap and standing behind an architrave supported by two columns. Only the tops of the columns are visible. A key, several books, two skulls, and a lamp rest on the architrave. A sun rises in the background, framing the woman, who stands at the center of the image.
dimensions: 6 1/8 x 8 or 8 x 6 1/8 inches, sheet, orientations vary
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
